fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Blade
fusions.desc: Fires the blade from its hilt, dealing 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Shrapnel Report
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of steel splinters 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Quick Draw
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Chambered
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
